scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
author: /root

contracts.definition: Preserve original clone request number and original args0..3 assignments exactly. Before its first send define only previously indeterminate args4 and5 as zero. Later phase1 and cleanup-kill rewrites retain original number/args0..1 changes, preserving all other now-initialized fields. No other cleanup-kill or clone semantic change is approved.
contracts.implementation: New initialization logic in Rust provider; any retained C fallback uses only a declaration/call to that Rust provider, with original logical source locations preserved. Root owns shared ABI/canonical integration.

contracts.definition: In selected Rust mem_helpers coredump retain number and args0..3 exactly; initialize only args4 and5 to zero before mem_core_syscall. Preserve every source field conversion, error convention and descriptor/table lifetime.
contracts.implementation: Private Root-owned mem_helpers patch may be prepared by Queue B; no whole-request zero, no helper-owned ID/valid writes. Preserve existing file/line macro identities.

limits: These are intentional defined transmitted-slot corrections. Selected host semantic consumers must independently be checked. No ACK, signal, lifetime, service/account/old rejected-native-operation clearance, native or build grant. Existing caller-order, whole-producer coverage and ABI proof remain.
